objective.krolasyonhorror.watch_tape1: Play the tape in the living room VCR
objective.krolasyonhorror.knocking: Find where the knocking came from
objective.krolasyonhorror.go_upstairs: Unlock the stair hall and go upstairs
objective.krolasyonhorror.fuses: Find the fuses for the fuse box (%s/3)
objective.krolasyonhorror.fusebox: Put the fuses in the fuse box in the storage room
objective.krolasyonhorror.watch_tv: The television changed channel. Go and watch it.
objective.krolasyonhorror.black_room: Reach the dark room behind the balloons. Don't look away.
objective.krolasyonhorror.candles: Light the birthday candles in the right order
objective.krolasyonhorror.watch_tape3: Play the party tape downstairs. It is awake now.

objective.krolasyonhorror.escape_attic: RUN. Get up into the attic!
objective.krolasyonhorror.dials: Tune Victor's transmitter to the right channel
objective.krolasyonhorror.escape_down: RUN. Get back to the living room.
objective.krolasyonhorror.final: Pay the rent... or evict the tenant.

note.krolasyonhorror.0.title: Work Order — Halloran Realty
note.krolasyonhorror.0.body:
JOB: VHS transfer, 5–6 tapes.
ADDRESS: 13 Ashgrove Lane.

Client will not be present. Key under the mat. Power is ON from 11 PM to 6 AM only.

DO NOT remove anything from the house.
DO NOT invite anyone over.

— J.H.
note.krolasyonhorror.1.title: Lena's Grocery List
note.krolasyonhorror.1.body:
- milk, bread, eggs
- D batteries (40!!)
- salt (the BIG bag)
- birthday candles: black, red, blue, white
- balloons, gold + white (Mira insists)
- a cake that says MIRA 9
- ask Victor about the TV. AGAIN.
note.krolasyonhorror.2.title: Repair Invoice — Ardel Electronics
note.krolasyonhorror.2.body:
Customer: V. Ardel (own set)
Model: 19" walnut console
Fault: will not power down.

Unplugged — still on.
Fuse pulled — still on.
Tube removed — STILL ON.

Picture is channel 13.
We don't get 13 here. Nobody does.

Charge: none. I'm not touching it again.
note.krolasyonhorror.3.title: Mira's Drawing
note.krolasyonhorror.3.body:
(A crayon drawing. A very tall man in a straw hat holds hands with a small girl. He is taller than the house behind them.)

Written underneath:
ME AND MR BRIM.
HE IS MY NAYBOR.
note.krolasyonhorror.4.title: Victor's Log — I
note.krolasyonhorror.4.body:
Sept 12, 1998.
The set came with the house. The last owners left it in the living room with a note taped to the screen: DON'T INVITE HIM.

The kids think it's funny.

Every night at nine it shows a children's program. Puppet-stage set, one host. Mira calls him Mr. Brim. I can't find a listing for it anywhere.
note.krolasyonhorror.5.title: Lena's Letter
note.krolasyonhorror.5.body:
Mum,

Something is wrong with the children. Mira has started tipping an imaginary hat at people. Oz won't sleep with his back to the door.

They say Mr. Brim told them you must never look away when a neighbor is talking to you.

I unplugged that television four times today. Four.

— Lena
note.krolasyonhorror.6.title: Mira's Diary — I
note.krolasyonhorror.6.body:
Dear Diary,

Mr Brim says if I am a good naybor he will come to my party. But you have to invite him properly. You have to say it to the TV three times.

Dad says NO.
Dad is not a good naybor.

Knock knock knock. That is how you know it is him.
note.krolasyonhorror.7.title: Oz's Note
note.krolasyonhorror.7.body:
(Crayon, pressed so hard the paper tore.)

HE IS TALL.
HE STANDS IN THE HALL WHEN THE LITES ARE OFF.
IF YOU LOOK AT HIM HE STOPS.
IF YOU DONT HE COMES.
note.krolasyonhorror.8.title: Victor's Log — II
note.krolasyonhorror.8.body:
Oct 3.
I measured the signal. It isn't coming in through the antenna. It's coming OUT. The set is transmitting.

The frequency drifts, but it always settles on four digits. I built a transmitter in the attic to follow it.

Lena wants to move. I told her we can't afford to break the lease. I don't remember signing a lease.
note.krolasyonhorror.9.title: Birthday Invitation
note.krolasyonhorror.9.body:
YOU'RE INVITED!
Mira is turning 9!

Saturday, November 1st, 1998 — 7 PM
13 Ashgrove Lane
Cake! Balloons! Games!

(On the back, in a child's handwriting:)
mr brim you are invited.
mr brim you are invited.
mr brim you are invited.
note.krolasyonhorror.10.title: Mira's Diary — II
note.krolasyonhorror.10.body:
We blow out the candles in order. Mr Brim says the one who pays first goes first.

Daddy is first because he is oldest.
Then Mummy.
Then Oz.
I go last because I am the one who invited him.

That is manners.
note.krolasyonhorror.11.title: Family Drawing
note.krolasyonhorror.11.body:
(A crayon drawing of a family holding hands. Each person is drawn in a single colour.)

DADDY — black
MUMMY — red
OZ — blue
ME — white

(Behind them, in yellow, a man so tall the paper had to be folded to fit him.)
note.krolasyonhorror.12.title: Victor's Log — III
note.krolasyonhorror.12.body:
Oct 30.
Called the station in Rellford. There is no channel 13. Called the federal office. They laughed.

Tonight the program ended and the host just stood there. He didn't look at the camera. He looked at me.

Then he said: "Rent's due on the second, Victor."
note.krolasyonhorror.13.title: Lena's Last Note
note.krolasyonhorror.13.body:
Nov 2, 4 AM.

Victor is gone. The television shows his armchair now. Empty. With the hat on it.

Oz is gone.

Mira is downstairs, talking to it. She's so calm.

I'm taking the attic key — Victor said everything is up there. If someone finds this: don't look away from him. And don't let her invite —
note.krolasyonhorror.14.title: Victor's Log — IV
note.krolasyonhorror.14.body:
It's not a broadcast. It's a lease.

Every twenty-eight years the house collects. It takes the family that lives here, one at a time, oldest first, until someone pays.

The four digits the signal settles on aren't a frequency. They're a date. The night it collects. Month, then day.
note.krolasyonhorror.15.title: Schematic, Scribbled Over
note.krolasyonhorror.15.body:
(Victor's wiring diagram: the television, the transmitter, an arrow pointing down into the house.)

Scrawled across it:
To END a lease the original recording — the MASTER — has to burn.
With the notice.
In a REAL fire.
Not on the set. NEVER on the set.
note.krolasyonhorror.16.title: Notice to Quit (Draft)
note.krolasyonhorror.16.body:
NOTICE TO QUIT

To the tenant of 13 Ashgrove Lane, known as "Mr. Brim":

You are hereby notified that your tenancy is terminated and you are to vacate the premises.

Signed,
V. Ardel, Owner

(The final copy is pinned beside the transmitter.)
note.krolasyonhorror.17.title: Oz's Letter
note.krolasyonhorror.17.body:
dear mr brim

i dont want to be next.
mira says it is good manners.
i hid under the bed
but you were already there.

from oz
note.krolasyonhorror.18.title: A Note on the Fridge
note.krolasyonhorror.18.body:
Recent ink, on clean paper:

"Leave the tapes on the table. Thank you.
— J."

The handwriting has the same looping, careful letters as the crayon notes upstairs. Only grown up.
note.krolasyonhorror.19.title: Rellford Courier, Nov 5 1998
note.krolasyonhorror.19.body:
FAMILY MISSING FROM ASHGROVE LANE

Victor Ardel (41), Lena Ardel (38) and their son Osman "Oz" (6) have not been seen since a birthday party on Saturday.

Their daughter Mira (9) was found unharmed in the living room, sitting in front of the television. She told officers: "They paid the rent."

She has been placed with relatives, the Hallorans.
credits.krolasyonhorror.1: an analog horror story for Minecraft
credits.krolasyonhorror.3: Story, models, animation, sound and code
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.0: Hi, this is June Halloran, Halloran Realty. Thank you for taking this on such short notice.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.1: The Ardel house has been sealed since ninety-eight. Everything's still inside. The furniture, the photographs... the tapes.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.2: There is a VCR in the living room. Watch them, copy them, leave them on the kitchen table. Your cheque will be in the mailbox by morning.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.3: The power's on for tonight only. So... please. Finish tonight.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.4: Oh — and the television. It does that. It's always on. Just... don't sit in front of it too long.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.5: The Ardels were lovely people. Goodnight.
story.krolasyonhorror.intro.6: (The door closes behind you. The lock turns on its own.)
story.krolasyonhorror.upstairs.0: (Upstairs is pitch black. The fuse box must still have its fuses somewhere.)
story.krolasyonhorror.power_on.1: (And downstairs, the television changes channel by itself.)
story.krolasyonhorror.mira_room.1: (The cake is still here. It hasn't rotted.)
story.krolasyonhorror.attic.0: (Victor's workshop. Every screen up here shows the same channel.)
story.krolasyonhorror.attic.1: (The transmitter has four dials. All of them set to zero.)
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.0: It's June. You found Victor's tape. I can tell — the house always gets louder when someone does.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.1: My name wasn't always Halloran. It was Mira. Mira Ardel.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.2: I invited him when I was nine. I didn't know what it meant. I know now.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.3: Every twenty-eight years the rent is due, and the house collects from whoever is living in it.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.4: Tonight, that is you. The lease is in your name. I signed it this morning.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.5: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. He's very polite... if you look at him.
story.krolasyonhorror.twist.6: Neighbors! We have a new tenant!
story.krolasyonhorror.end_host.1: Welcome to the Neighborly Hour. Rent... paid in full.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_host.2: Twenty-eight years later, a new family moved into 13 Ashgrove Lane.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_host.3: Their daughter loves the television. She says the host is very polite.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_evict.0: (The tape curls in the fire. The notice goes with it.)
story.krolasyonhorror.end_evict.2: At dawn, the television in the living room was finally dark.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_evict.3: Somewhere across town, June Halloran's television turned itself on.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_return.0: (You write an address on the master tape: June Halloran.)
story.krolasyonhorror.end_return.1: A forwarding address! How very neighborly.
story.krolasyonhorror.end_return.2: June Halloran opened her mailbox at 6:02 AM. Inside was a tape, and a note: 'You invited him. You keep him.'
story.krolasyonhorror.end_return.3: Her television has been on ever since.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.0: Okay, it's recording. Say hi, Mira. Say hi to future Mira.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.1: Hi, future me. Tomorrow I'm nine.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.2: And what do you want for your birthday?
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.3: I want Mr. Brim to come.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.4: ...Honey, Mr. Brim is a TV show.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.5: He's not. He stands in the hall at night.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.6: Mr. Brim says a good neighbor always knocks. And you have to invite him properly. Three times.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.7: Nobody is inviting anybody. Turn that thing off.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape1.label: MIRA — OCT 31
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.0: Hello, hello, neighbors! Welcome back to the Neighborly Hour.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.1: Last time we learned that a good neighbor always knocks. Knock, knock, knock.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.2: Today's lesson is a very important one. Are you listening? Good.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.3: When a neighbor is talking to you... you look at them.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.4: You never, ever look away. Looking away is rude.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.6: Let's practice. I'll stand very still. You keep looking at me.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.7: ...You looked away. That's all right. Everybody does, the first time.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape2.label: CH 13
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.0: Everybody ready? Victor, get the lights!
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.1: (Everyone sings. One voice, off-key, is louder than all the others.)
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.2: I have to blow them in order. Daddy's first.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.3: Whose voice is that? Who's singing?
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.7: Lesson three, neighbors: everybody pays the rent.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.8: One at a time. Oldest first. The landlord is very patient.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.9: Twenty-eight years is nothing to a landlord.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape3.label: PARTY!!
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.0: If this is playing, the dials are set right, and it's come back. So it's been twenty-eight years. I'm sorry.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.1: My name is Victor Ardel. I built this transmitter to find where the signal comes from. It comes from the house.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.2: The house rents itself out. To families. And every twenty-eight years, the rent is due.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.3: It takes whoever lives here. One at a time, oldest first. Until someone pays it willingly... or someone evicts it.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.4: Mira invited it in. She didn't know. She's nine.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.5: I'm going to pay tonight, so the kids don't have to. If it's not enough... the master tape is behind the set in the living room.
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.6: Burn it with the notice. In a real fire. And whatever you do—
tape.krolasyonhorror.tape4.label: FOR WHOEVER COMES NEXT
